attempts.plan: I will replace the legacy Date/Calendar/SimpleDateFormat utilities with java.time.ZonedDateTime and java.time.LocalDate to correctly handle the Warsaw time zone, leap years, and accurate calendar arithmetic. This avoids the thread-safety issues of SimpleDateFormat and the server-local timezone dependency of Calendar.

The legacy implementation uses a hardcoded 2026 year for holidays and fails to correctly handle the instant-to-local conversion for the processing date logic, leading to off-by-one errors during DST transitions and year-specific holiday checking. I will rewrite the holiday logic to be year-agnostic and ensure the processing date correctly shifts to the next business day using the specified Warsaw timezone logic.
